reply.text:
Whether it's safe for you is a question for your doctor, not a coach, so I'd get a quick okay from them before you start, especially if you have any health conditions or take medication. Once you have it, starting is very doable. Lifting at 78 is common and well worth doing: begin light, learn the movements, and build slowly.

When you're ready, tell me how many days a week you can train and what equipment you have, and I'll set up a beginner program for you to check and confirm.
